title: G7 complete preflight accepted a plan profile inconsistent with the executable protocol
evidence: Before repair, a valid complete G7 fixture with every profile changed from theory_benchmark to law_discovery returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[] under require_complete_plan=True, although the runner prompt and immutable formal plan use theory_benchmark.
remediation: Require exact profile=theory_benchmark for every complete-plan row, add an adversarial wrong-profile test, and independently verify the immutable formal plan.
